title: ¿Quién es tu amiga?
setting: Emma ve una foto tuya con una amiga y te pregunta por ella.

says.t: Hi Yolanda! Who's the woman in your photo?
says.es: ¡Hola, Yolanda! ¿Quién es la mujer de tu foto?

options.t: She's my friend. She lives in my street.
options.es: Es mi amiga. Vive en mi calle.

options.t: She's my friend. She live in my street.
options.es: Es mi amiga. Vive en mi calle.
options.feedback: Con she el verbo lleva -s: she lives (suena /z/: «livz»).

options.t: She's my friend. She is live in my street.
options.es: Es mi amiga. Vive en mi calle.
options.feedback: No hace falta is: she lives.

says.t: She looks nice! What does she do?

options.t: She's a nurse. She works in a hospital.
options.es: Es enfermera. Trabaja en un hospital.

options.t: She's nurse. She works in a hospital.
options.es: Es enfermera. Trabaja en un hospital.
options.feedback: Las profesiones llevan a: she's a nurse.

options.t: She's a nurse. She work in a hospital.
options.es: Es enfermera. Trabaja en un hospital.

options.t: Yes, she does. On Mondays and Tuesdays.
options.es: Sí. Los lunes y los martes.

options.t: Yes, she do. On Mondays and Tuesdays.
options.es: Sí. Los lunes y los martes.
options.feedback: La respuesta corta con she es: Yes, she does.

options.t: Yes, she works. On Mondays and Tuesdays.
options.es: Sí. Los lunes y los martes.
options.feedback: Se entiende, pero lo natural es la respuesta corta: Yes, she does.

says.t: That's hard. Does she have children?

options.t: No, she doesn't. But she has a big dog!
No, she don't. But she has a big dog!
options.feedback: Con she: No, she doesn't. «She don't» es un error muy típico.

options.t: No, she doesn't. But she haves a big dog!
options.feedback: Have con she es has: she has a big dog.

says.t: My brother has a big dog too. He doesn't walk it much!
says.es: Mi hermano también tiene un perro grande. ¡No lo saca mucho!

options.t: Ha ha! Does your brother live in London?
Ha ha! Does your brother lives in London?
options.feedback: Después de does, el verbo sin -s: Does your brother live…?

says.t: Yes, he does. He has a flat near Camden Market.
says.es: Sí. Tiene un piso cerca de Camden Market.

options.t: Lovely! Say hello to him from me.
Lovely! Say hello to her from me.
